rulebook.guidance.call-sfpd-non-emergenc: Call SFPD non-emergency on 415-553-0123 when sidewalk is partially or fully blocked.
rulebook.guidance.encampment-resolution-: Encampment resolution is the City's responsibility. Use the app to file a 311 ticket.
rulebook.guidance.if-an-animal-is-attack: If an animal is attacking someone, call 911 now.
rulebook.guidance.if-it-looks-unsafe-but: If it looks unsafe but nothing is on fire, and it's on the weekend, use the app to file a 311 ticket.
If it looks unsafe but nothing is on fire, and it's after business hours, use the app to file a 311 ticket.
If it looks unsafe but nothing is on fire, Monday to Friday, 8 am to 5 pm, call SFFD on 415-558-3300.
If it looks unsafe but nothing is on fire, use the app to file a 311 ticket.
rulebook.guidance.if-it-s-a-stray-or-unk: If it's a stray or unknown animal, call Animal Care and Control on 415-554-9400
rulebook.guidance.if-it-s-an-object-not-: If it's an object (not a person) blocking the path, use the app to file a 311 ticket.
rulebook.guidance.if-it-s-not-your-clien: If it's not your client, or it doesn't feel safe, call 911.
If it's not your client or resident, call 911. Do not try to handle it yourself.
If it's not your client, report it to the City. Don't step in.
rulebook.guidance.if-it-s-your-client-an: If it's your client and it's safe, talk to them calmly. Offer to connect them with help.
rulebook.guidance.if-it-s-your-client-it: If it's your client, it's not an emergency, and it's safe, talk to them gently and offer to connect them with help.
rulebook.guidance.if-it-s-your-client-or: If it's your client or guest, and it's safe, just ask them to move.
If it's your client or resident and it feels safe, talk to them gently and offer to connect them with help.
If it's your client or resident and you feel safe, ask them to clear the path, including any belongings causing the blockage.
rulebook.guidance.if-it-turns-violent-or: If it turns violent or a weapon is involved, do not get involved. Move to safety and call 911.
rulebook.guidance.if-someone-is-hurt-in-: If someone is hurt, in pain, or not waking up, call 911 now. Don't wait, even if other people are already helping.
rulebook.guidance.if-someone-is-in-real-: If someone is in real danger right now, call 911. The City will send the right team to help.
rulebook.guidance.if-someone-just-looks-: If someone just looks tired or a little unwell, check in and offer help. Keep an eye on them in case it gets worse.
rulebook.guidance.if-someone-looks-like-: If someone looks like they may be overdosing or in serious trouble, call 911 now.
rulebook.guidance.if-the-animal-belongs-: If the animal belongs to one of your clients, remind them to leash it and pick up its waste.
rulebook.guidance.if-the-graffiti-is-not: If the graffiti is not on your property, report it to the City instead of cleaning it yourself.
rulebook.guidance.if-the-graffiti-is-on-: If the graffiti is on your own building, remove it yourself within 3 days.
rulebook.guidance.if-the-item-is-yours-l: If the item is yours (like old furniture from your program), call Recology (or a private hauler) to set up a pickup.
rulebook.guidance.if-the-item-isn-t-your: If the item isn't yours, report it to the City. You don't have to move it.
rulebook.guidance.if-the-path-is-badly-b: If the path is badly blocked, or they won't move, call the SFPD non-emergency line: 415-553-0123.
rulebook.guidance.if-there-is-a-small-am: If there is a small amount of trash, pick it up yourself during your regular checks.
rulebook.guidance.if-there-is-too-much-t: If there is too much trash for you to clean up, you can use the app to file a 311 ticket and ask the City for help.
rulebook.guidance.if-they-tell-you-they-: If they tell you they need medical help, call 911 immediately.
rulebook.guidance.if-you-see-fire-smoke-: If you see fire, smoke, or something about to catch fire, call 911 now.
rulebook.guidance.illegal-parking-issues: Illegal parking issues are reported via 311, but we can't file this automatically for you. Call 311 to explain the problem.
rulebook.guidance.it-s-outside-of-animal: It's outside of Animal Care and Control opening hours. File a ticket with the City and 311 will route it appropriately.
rulebook.guidance.never-pick-up-a-needle: Never pick up a needle yourself. SFAF will come pick it up safely. Call 415-818-7769.
Never pick up a needle yourself. Use the app to file a 311 ticket so the City can safely remove it.
rulebook.guidance.potential-hate-speech-: Potential hate speech, especially on the side of a place of worship, must be investigated by the SFPD. Call 911.
rulebook.guidance.stay-away-from-it-use-: Stay away from it. Use the app to file a 311 ticket so the City can clean it up.
rulebook.guidance.when-someone-is-active: When someone is actively spraying graffiti, call the SFPD non-emergency line.
rulebook.guidance.when-the-waste-is-from: When the waste is from an animal owned by a client or resident, ask them to clean it up.
rulebook.label.ask-the-animal-s-owner-to: Ask the animal's owner to clean this up.
rulebook.label.ask-the-city-to-clean-the: Ask the City to clean the graffiti.
Ask the City to clean the street.
rulebook.label.call-sf-animal-care-and-c: Call SF Animal Care and Control.
rulebook.label.do-not-touch-it-report-it: Do not touch it. Report it to the City.
rulebook.label.do-not-touch-the-needle-c: Do not touch the needle. Call it in to SFAF.
rulebook.label.do-not-touch-the-needle-r: Do not touch the needle. Report it to the City.
rulebook.label.don-t-remove-report-to-th: Don't remove. Report to the City.
rulebook.label.report-it-do-not-move-it-: Report it. Do not move it yourself.
rulebook.label.report-it-do-not-try-to-h: Report it. Do not try to handle it yourself.
rulebook.label.speak-to-them-about-their: Speak to them about their animal.
